sampling: Stable pre-edge VALID & READY at rising AXI/NoC edge, 1 ps VCD
boundary: Common ENABLE origin; durations are timestamp differences, not inclusive BW windows
stages: All 128 bursts/case: accepted source AR to first accepted R; target AR-to-first-R includes waiting
figure_selection: node-stages: arithmetic mean of all eight bursts/node, durations aligned at source AR; node-timeline: all bursts at common ENABLE; node-first: transaction 0 at common ENABLE
mean_formula: Each component: sum of its stage durations across all eight bursts / 8; four components sum to mean(source first R - source AR) / clock period
limits: Boundary residence intervals include pipeline/waiting; no arbitration/FIFO causal attribution
checks: AXI payload/timestamps vs raw collector and transaction tables; one-to-one device pairing; REQ address/tag per hop; DAT RDATA/RLAST/tag/beat-order per hop; each beat chronological; stages sum to original first-R latency
